FeedbackView

class FeedbackView(settings, sound_enabled=True)[source]

Bases: object

Play the sound and show the feedback image of a KillResult.

A positive result (collided with a target, avoided an obstacle) plays the hit sound and shows the positive image; a negative one, the miss sound and the negative image. The image is centered at 20% of the screen height and stays visible for settings.FEEDBACK_IMAGE_TIME seconds (configurable per player, 0 to 2 s). With 0 the image appears for a single frame, as in the original game. A new result replaces the current image and restarts the count.

Use every frame: show when there is a result and draw after drawing the road, the car and the HUD.

Parameters:
settingsGameSettings

Game configuration (sounds, images and display time).

sound_enabledbool, optional

Initial sound state. Defaults to True.

Attributes:
settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

soundsdict[bool, pygame.mixer.Sound]

Hit (True) and miss (False) sounds.

imagesdict[bool, pygame.Surface]

Positive (True) and negative (False) images.

durationfloat

Display time (s) of an image.

currentbool | None

Image being shown (True positive, False negative), or None.

time_leftfloat

Seconds left to show the current image.

Methods

clear

Remove the image being shown (e.g. when a level starts).

draw

Draw the image being shown and subtract the frame time.

set_sound_enabled

Turn the feedback sounds on or off.

show

Play the sound and start showing the image of the result.
set_sound_enabled(enabled)[source]

Turn the feedback sounds on or off.

Parameters:
enabledbool

True sets the volume to 1; False mutes the sounds.

show(surface, result)[source]

Play the sound and start showing the image of the result.

The image is drawn by draw, from this same frame on, until the configured time is complete.

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

Game screen (not used; drawing happens in draw).

resultKillResult
